profile.legalName: Hanna, Brophy, MacLean, McAleer & Jensen, LLP
profile.summary: A California law firm that focuses on defending employers in workers' compensation cases. It has about 140 attorneys in offices across the state, including Oakland. It also has a practice group that represents public entities such as school districts and special districts.

review.notes: The firm's own site confirms the legal name, a workers' comp defense focus, nearly 140 attorneys, an Oakland office at 555 12th St 18th Floor with phone 510-839-1180, and a public entity group serving school districts; this fits OUSD Risk Management and General Counsel. No cited source says Oakland is the headquarters (it is one of 15 offices), so headquarters is dropped.
